        //                        INITIALIZATION

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    315
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    316
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    317
                                    
        /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    318
                                    
        constructor() {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    319
                                    
            _disableInitializers();

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    320
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    321
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    322
                                    
        function initialize(address _oracle) public initializer {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    323
                                    
            __Ownable_init();

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    324
                                    
            __UUPSUpgradeable_init();

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    325
                                    
            __ReentrancyGuard_init();

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    326
                                    
            __Pausable_init();

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    327
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    328
                                    
            // Set up first oracle

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    329
                                    
            oracles[0] = _oracle;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    330
                                    
            oracleCount = 1;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    331
                                    
            oracleThreshold = 1;  // Start with 1-of-1, upgrade to 2-of-3 later

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    332
                                    
            isOracle[_oracle] = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    333
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    334
                                    
            approvalThreshold = 1;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    335
                                    
            globalRiskThreshold = HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    336
                                    
            activeModelVersion = "DQN-v1.0";

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    337
                                    
            policyEngineEnabled = false;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    338
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    339
                                    
            // Add deployer as first approver

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    340
                                    
            approvers.push(msg.sender);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    341
                                    
            isApprover[msg.sender] = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    342
                                    
            // Set governance to owner by default (can be changed)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    343
                                    
            governance = msg.sender;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    344
                                    
            isUpgradeApprover[msg.sender] = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    345
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    346
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    347
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    348
                                    
        //                     UPGRADE TIMELOCK & GOVERNANCE

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    349
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    350
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    351
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    352
                                    
         * @notice Set governance address (multisig or DAO)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    353
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    354
                                    
        function setGovernance(address _governance) external onlyOwner {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    355
                                    
            require(_governance != address(0), "Invalid governance");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    356
                                    
            governance = _governance;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    357
                                    
            isUpgradeApprover[_governance] = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    358
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    359
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    360
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    361
                                    
         * @notice Add or remove upgrade approvers (multisig/DAO members)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    362
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    363
                                    
        function setUpgradeApprover(address approver, bool approved) external {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    364
                                    
            require(msg.sender == governance || msg.sender == owner(), "Not authorized");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    365
                                    
            isUpgradeApprover[approver] = approved;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    366
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    367
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    368
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    369
                                    
         * @notice Queue an upgrade (timelocked)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    370
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    371
                                    
        function queueUpgrade(address newImplementation) external onlyOwner returns (bytes32 upgradeId) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    372
                                    
            require(newImplementation != address(0), "Invalid implementation");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    373
                                    
            upgradeId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(newImplementation, block.timestamp));

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    374
                                    
            upgradeQueue[upgradeId] = UpgradeRequest({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    375
                                    
                newImplementation: newImplementation,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    376
                                    
                executeAfter: block.timestamp + UPGRADE_TIMELOCK,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    377
                                    
                executed: false

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    378
                                    
            });

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    379
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    380
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    381
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    382
                                    
         * @notice Approve and execute upgrade after timelock

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    383
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    384
                                    
        function executeUpgrade(bytes32 upgradeId) external {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    385
                                    
            require(isUpgradeApprover[msg.sender], "Not upgrade approver");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    386
                                    
            UpgradeRequest storage req = upgradeQueue[upgradeId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    387
                                    
            require(req.newImplementation != address(0), "Not queued");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    388
                                    
            require(block.timestamp >= req.executeAfter, "Timelock not expired");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    389
                                    
            require(!req.executed, "Already executed");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    390
                                    
            req.executed = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    391
                                    
            _upgradeTo(req.newImplementation);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    392
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    393
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    394
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    395
                                    
        //              MULTI-ORACLE MANAGEMENT (Security Enhancement 1)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    396
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    397
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    398
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    399
                                    
         * @notice Add a new oracle (HSM-backed address)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    400
                                    
         * @param _oracle The oracle address (should be HSM-controlled)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    401
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    402
                                    
        function addOracle(address _oracle) external onlyOwner {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    403
                                    
            require(oracleCount < MAX_ORACLES, "Max oracles reached");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    404
                                    
            require(!isOracle[_oracle], "Already oracle");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    405
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    406
                                    
            oracles[oracleCount] = _oracle;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    407
                                    
            isOracle[_oracle] = true;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    408
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    409
                                    
            emit OracleAdded(_oracle, oracleCount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    410
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    411
                                    
            unchecked {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    412
                                    
                oracleCount++;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    413
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    414
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    415
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    416
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    417
                                    
         * @notice Remove an oracle

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    418
                                    
         * @param _oracle The oracle address to remove

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    419
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    420
                                    
        function removeOracle(address _oracle) external onlyOwner {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    421
                                    
            require(isOracle[_oracle], "Not oracle");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    422
                                    
            require(oracleCount > oracleThreshold, "Would break threshold");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    423
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    424
                                    
            isOracle[_oracle] = false;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    425
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    426
                                    
            // Compact the array

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    427
                                    
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < oracleCount; i++) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    428
                                    
                if (oracles[i] == _oracle) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    429
                                    
                    oracles[i] = oracles[oracleCount - 1];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    430
                                    
                    oracles[oracleCount - 1] = address(0);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    431
                                    
                    break;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    432
                                    
                }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    433
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    434
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    435
                                    
            unchecked {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    436
                                    
                oracleCount--;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    437
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    438
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    439
                                    
            emit OracleRemoved(_oracle);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    440
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    441
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    442
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    443
                                    
         * @notice Set oracle threshold (e.g., 2-of-3)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    444
                                    
         * @param _threshold Number of required signatures

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    445
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    446
                                    
        function setOracleThreshold(uint256 _threshold) external onlyOwner {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    447
                                    
            require(_threshold > 0 && _threshold <= oracleCount, "Invalid threshold");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    448
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    449
                                    
            emit OracleThresholdUpdated(oracleThreshold, _threshold);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    450
                                    
            oracleThreshold = _threshold;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    451
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    452
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    453
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    454
                                    
        //              TIMELOCK FUNCTIONS (Security Enhancement 2)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    455
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    456
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    457
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    458
                                    
         * @notice Queue a timelocked admin operation

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    459
                                    
         * @param operation The type of operation

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    460
                                    
         * @param data The encoded operation data

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    461
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    462
                                    
        function queueTimelock(TimelockOperation operation, bytes calldata data) external onlyOwner returns (bytes32 operationId) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    463
                                    
            operationId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(operation, data, block.timestamp));

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    464
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    465
                                    
            uint256 executeAfter;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    466
                                    
            unchecked {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    467
                                    
                executeAfter = block.timestamp + TIMELOCK_DELAY;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    468
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    469
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    470
                                    
            timelockQueue[operationId] = TimelockItem({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    471
                                    
                executeAfter: executeAfter,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    472
                                    
                data: data,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    473
                                    
                executed: false

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    474
                                    
            });

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    475
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    476
                                    
            emit TimelockQueued(operationId, operation, executeAfter);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    477
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    478
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    479
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    480

                                    915

            }

        }

        function rejectSwap(bytes32 swapId, string calldata reason) external onlyApprover swapExists(swapId) {

        /**

                                    961

        // ============================================================

                                    141

            // Emit MetaEvidence for this dispute type

                                    144
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    145
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    146
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    147
                                    
        // ESCROW FUNCTIONS

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    148
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    149
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    150
                                    
        /**

        function escrowTransaction(

            escrows[_txId] = EscrowedTransaction({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    171
                                    
                txId: _txId,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    172

                                    173

                                    174

                _recipient,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    192
                                    
                address(0),

                                    194
                                    
                _riskScore,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    195
                                    
                deadline

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    196
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    197

            // Auto-submit ML evidence

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    199
                                    
            if (bytes(_evidenceURI).length > 0) {

                                    204
                                    
        /**

                                    206

                                    208
                                    
        function challengeTransaction(bytes32 _txId) external payable nonReentrant {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    209
                                    
            EscrowedTransaction storage escrow = escrows[_txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    210
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    211
                                    
            require(escrow.status == EscrowStatus.Pending, "Not challengeable");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    212
                                    
            require(block.timestamp < escrow.challengeDeadline, "Challenge window closed");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    213
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    214
                                    
            // Get arbitration cost

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    215
                                    
            uint256 arbitrationCost = arbitrator.arbitrationCost(EXTRA_DATA);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    216
                                    
            require(msg.value >= arbitrationCost, "Insufficient arbitration fee");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    217
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    218
                                    
            // CEI: Update state BEFORE external call to prevent reentrancy

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    219
                                    
            escrow.status = EscrowStatus.Challenged;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    220
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    221
                                    
            // Create dispute in Kleros

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    222
                                    
            uint256 disputeID = arbitrator.createDispute{value: arbitrationCost}(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    223
                                    
                RULING_OPTIONS,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    224
                                    
                EXTRA_DATA

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    225
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    226
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    227
                                    
            // Update remaining state after getting disputeID

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    228
                                    
            escrow.disputeID = disputeID;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    229
                                    
            disputeToTx[disputeID] = _txId;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    230
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    231
                                    
            // Emit dispute event for Kleros

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    232
                                    
            emit Dispute(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    233
                                    
                arbitrator,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    234
                                    
                disputeID,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    235
                                    
                metaEvidenceID,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    236
                                    
                txToEvidenceGroup[_txId]

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    237
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    238
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    239
                                    
            emit TransactionChallenged(_txId, msg.sender, disputeID);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    240
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    241
                                    
            // Refund excess

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    242
                                    
            if (msg.value > arbitrationCost) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    243
                                    
                payable(msg.sender).transfer(msg.value - arbitrationCost);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    244
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    245
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    246
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    247
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    248
                                    
         * @notice Escrow an ERC20 token for potential dispute

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    249
                                    
         * @param _txId Unique transaction identifier

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    250
                                    
         * @param _recipient Intended recipient of funds

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    251
                                    
         * @param _token ERC20 token address

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    252
                                    
         * @param _amount Amount of tokens to escrow

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    253
                                    
         * @param _riskScore Risk score from ML model (0-1000)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    254
                                    
         * @param _evidenceURI IPFS URI with ML evidence

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    255
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    256
                                    
        function escrowTransactionERC20(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    257
                                    
            bytes32 _txId,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    258
                                    
            address _recipient,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    259
                                    
            address _token,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    260
                                    
            uint256 _amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    261
                                    
            uint256 _riskScore,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    262
                                    
            string calldata _evidenceURI

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    263
                                    
        ) external nonReentrant {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    264
                                    
            require(_amount > 0, "No funds sent");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    265
                                    
            require(_recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    266
                                    
            require(_token != address(0), "Invalid token");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    267
                                    
            require(escrows[_txId].status == EscrowStatus.None, "TX already exists");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    268
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    269
                                    
            uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + challengeWindow;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    270
                                    
            uint256 evidenceGroup = ++evidenceGroupCounter;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    271
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    272
                                    
            // Transfer tokens to contract

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    273
                                    
            IERC20(_token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    274
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    275
                                    
            escrows[_txId] = EscrowedTransaction({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    276
                                    
                txId: _txId,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    277
                                    
                sender: msg.sender,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    278
                                    
                recipient: _recipient,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    279
                                    
                token: _token,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    280
                                    
                amount: _amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    281
                                    
                riskScore: _riskScore,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    282
                                    
                createdAt: block.timestamp,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    283
                                    
                challengeDeadline: deadline,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    284
                                    
                status: EscrowStatus.Pending,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    285
                                    
                disputeID: 0,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    286
                                    
                ruling: 0,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    287
                                    
                partialPct: 0,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    288
                                    
                evidenceURI: _evidenceURI

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    289
                                    
            });

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    290
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    291
                                    
            txToEvidenceGroup[_txId] = evidenceGroup;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    292
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    293
                                    
            emit TransactionEscrowed(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    294
                                    
                _txId,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    295
                                    
                msg.sender,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    296
                                    
                _recipient,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    297
                                    
                _token,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    298
                                    
                _amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    299
                                    
                _riskScore,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    300
                                    
                deadline

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    301
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    302
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    303
                                    
            if (bytes(_evidenceURI).length > 0) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    304
                                    
                emit Evidence(arbitrator, evidenceGroup, msg.sender, _evidenceURI);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    305
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    306
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    307
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    308
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    309
                                    
         * @notice Submit additional evidence for a dispute

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    310
                                    
         * @param _txId Transaction ID

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    311
                                    
         * @param _evidenceURI IPFS URI with evidence

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    312
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    313
                                    
        function submitEvidence(bytes32 _txId, string calldata _evidenceURI) external {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    314
                                    
            EscrowedTransaction storage escrow = escrows[_txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    315
                                    
            require(escrow.status == EscrowStatus.Challenged, "No active dispute");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    316
                                    
            require(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    317
                                    
                msg.sender == escrow.sender || msg.sender == escrow.recipient,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    318
                                    
                "Not a party"

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    319
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    320
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    321
                                    
            emit Evidence(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    322
                                    
                arbitrator,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    323
                                    
                txToEvidenceGroup[_txId],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    324
                                    
                msg.sender,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    325
                                    
                _evidenceURI

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    326
                                    
            );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    327
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    328
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    329
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    330
                                    
        // KLEROS CALLBACK

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    331
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    332
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    333
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    334
                                    
         * @notice Called by Kleros when jurors reach a ruling

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    335
                                    
         * @param _disputeID The dispute ID

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    336
                                    
         * @param _ruling 1 = Approve (release to recipient), 2 = Reject (return to sender)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    337
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    338
                                    
        function rule(uint256 _disputeID, uint256 _ruling) external override {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    339
                                    
            require(msg.sender == address(arbitrator), "Only arbitrator");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    340
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    341
                                    
            bytes32 txId = disputeToTx[_disputeID];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    342
                                    
            require(txId != bytes32(0), "Unknown dispute");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    343
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    344
                                    
            EscrowedTransaction storage escrow = escrows[txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    345
                                    
            require(escrow.status == EscrowStatus.Challenged, "Not challenged");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    346
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    347
                                    
            escrow.status = EscrowStatus.Resolved;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    348
                                    
            escrow.ruling = _ruling;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    349
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    350
                                    
        // If arbitrator provided extra metadata indicating a partial pct, we don't have it here.

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    351
                                    
        // Owners/operators can set defaultPartialPct per-escrow in advance if needed via setEscrowPartialPct.

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    352
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    353
                                    
            emit Ruling(arbitrator, _disputeID, _ruling);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    354
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    355
                                    
            // Execute ruling

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    356
                                    
            _executeRuling(txId);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    357
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    358
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    359
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    360
                                    
        // EXECUTION

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    361
                                    
        // ============================================================

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    362
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    363
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    364
                                    
         * @notice Execute the ruling or release after challenge window

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    365
                                    
         * @param _txId Transaction to execute

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    366
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    367
                                    
        function executeTransaction(bytes32 _txId) external nonReentrant {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    368
                                    
            EscrowedTransaction storage escrow = escrows[_txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    369
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    370
                                    
            if (escrow.status == EscrowStatus.Pending) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    371
                                    
                // No challenge - release after window expires

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    372
                                    
                require(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    373
                                    
                    block.timestamp >= escrow.challengeDeadline,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    374

                                    481

                                    484
                                    
            );

                                    488
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    489
                                    
        function executeDisputeRuling(bytes32 swapId, bool releaseTobuyer) external {

                                    166
                                    
        function setTransactionPolicy(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    167
                                    
            address user,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    168
                                    
            uint256 maxAmount,

                                    181

                                    185
                                    
                riskThreshold: riskThreshold,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    186
                                    
                allowedCounterparties: userPolicies[user].allowedCounterparties,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    187

            });

                                    197
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    198

                                    199
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    200
                                    
        function setRiskPolicy(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    201
                                    
            address user,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    202
                                    
            uint256[4] memory thresholds, // [minimal, low, medium, high]

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    203
                                    
            PolicyAction[4] memory actions,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    204
                                    
            bool adaptiveThresholds

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    205
                                    
        ) external {

            require(msg.sender == user || msg.sender == owner(), "Unauthorized");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    207
                                    
            require(thresholds[0] < thresholds[1] && thresholds[1] < thresholds[2] && thresholds[2] < thresholds[3], "Invalid thresholds");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    208
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    209
                                    
            userRiskPolicies[user] = RiskPolicy({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    210
                                    
                minimalThreshold: thresholds[0],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    211
                                    
                lowThreshold: thresholds[1],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    212
                                    
                mediumThreshold: thresholds[2],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    213
                                    
                highThreshold: thresholds[3],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    214
                                    
                minimalAction: actions[0],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    215
                                    
                lowAction: actions[1],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    216
                                    
                mediumAction: actions[2],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    217
                                    
                highAction: actions[3],

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    218
                                    
                adaptiveThresholds: adaptiveThresholds

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    219
                                    
            });

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    220
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    221
                                    
            emit PolicyUpdated(user, "risk");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    222
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    223
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    224
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    225
                                    
         * @dev Add velocity limit for a user

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    226
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    227
                                    
        function addVelocityLimit(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    228
                                    
            address user,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    229
                                    
            uint256 maxTransactions,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    230
