                                    231
                                    
            VelocityWindow window

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    232
                                    
        ) external {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    233
                                    
            require(msg.sender == user || msg.sender == owner(), "Unauthorized");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    234
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    235
                                    
            userVelocityLimits[user].push(VelocityLimit({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    236
                                    
                maxTransactions: maxTransactions,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    237
                                    
                maxVolume: maxVolume,

                                    239
                                    
                enabled: true

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    240
                                    
            }));

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    241

            emit PolicyUpdated(user, "velocity");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    243
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    244
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    245
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    246
                                    
         * @dev Set compliance rules for a user

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    247
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    248
                                    
        function setComplianceRules(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    249
                                    
            address user,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    250
                                    
            bool requireKYC,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    251
                                    
            bool requireApproval,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    252
                                    
            uint256 approvalThreshold,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    253
                                    
            uint256 approvalTimeout,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    254
                                    
            bool geofencing

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    255
                                    
        ) external {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    256
                                    
            require(msg.sender == user || msg.sender == owner(), "Unauthorized");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    257
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    258
                                    
            userComplianceRules[user].requireKYC = requireKYC;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    259
                                    
            userComplianceRules[user].requireApproval = requireApproval;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    260
                                    
            userComplianceRules[user].approvalThreshold = approvalThreshold;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    261
                                    
            userComplianceRules[user].approvalTimeout = approvalTimeout;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    262
                                    
            userComplianceRules[user].geofencing = geofencing;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    263
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    264
                                    
            emit PolicyUpdated(user, "compliance");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    265
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    266
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    267
                                    
        // ---------------- Transaction Validation ----------------

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    268
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    269
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    270
                                    
         * @dev Validate transaction against user policies and DQN risk score

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    271
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    272
                                    
        function validateTransaction(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    273
                                    
            address user,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    274
                                    
            address counterparty,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    275
                                    
            uint256 amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    276
                                    
            uint256 dqnRiskScore,        // Risk score from your DQN model (0-1000)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    277
                                    
            string memory modelVersion,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    278
                                    
            bytes32 kycHash

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    279
                                    
        ) external onlyAMTTP notPaused notFrozen(user) returns (PolicyAction action, string memory reason) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    280
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    281
                                    
            // Update user activity

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    282
                                    
            _updateUserActivity(user, amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    283
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    284
                                    
            // Check model version

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    285
                                    
            require(modelVersionScores[modelVersion] >= minimumModelScore, "Model version not approved");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    286
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    287
                                    
            // Get user policies (with defaults if not set)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    288
                                    
            TransactionPolicy memory policy = _getUserPolicyWithDefaults(user);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    289
                                    
            RiskPolicy memory riskPolicy = _getUserRiskPolicyWithDefaults(user);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    290
                                    
            ComplianceRule memory compliance = userComplianceRules[user];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    291
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    292
                                    
            // 1. Basic policy checks

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    293
                                    
            if (amount > policy.maxAmount) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    294
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Block, "Exceeds maximum amount");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    295
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    296
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    297
                                    
            // 2. Velocity checks

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    298
                                    
            if (!_checkVelocityLimits(user, amount)) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    299
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Block, "Velocity limit exceeded");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    300
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    301
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    302
                                    
            // 3. Counterparty checks

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    303
                                    
            if (_isBlockedCounterparty(user, counterparty)) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    304
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Block, "Blocked counterparty");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    305
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    306
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    307
                                    
            // 4. KYC compliance

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    308
                                    
            if (compliance.requireKYC && kycHash == bytes32(0)) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    309
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Block, "KYC required");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    310
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    311
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    312
                                    
            // 5. DQN Risk Assessment - Your trained model integration

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    313
                                    
            PolicyAction riskAction = _assessDQNRisk(dqnRiskScore, riskPolicy);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    314
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    315
                                    
            // 6. HIGH RISK: Auto-block and flag for Kleros dispute

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    316
                                    
            // Transactions with risk score >= 700 are auto-blocked

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    317
                                    
            if (riskAction == PolicyAction.Block) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    318
                                    
                emit HighRiskAutoBlocked(user, counterparty, amount, dqnRiskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    319
                                    
                emit RiskThresholdExceeded(user, dqnRiskScore, riskPolicy.mediumThreshold);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    320
                                    
                // Caller should route to Kleros escrow via routeToKlerosEscrow()

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    321
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Block, "HIGH_RISK: Auto-blocked - route to Kleros for dispute");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    322
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    323
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    324
                                    
            // 7. MEDIUM RISK: Flag for human review

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    325
                                    
            // Transactions with risk score 400-699 need manual verification

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    326
                                    
            if (riskAction == PolicyAction.Review) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    327
                                    
                emit MediumRiskFlagged(user, counterparty, amount, dqnRiskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    328
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Review, "MEDIUM_RISK: Flagged for human review");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    329
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    330
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    331
                                    
            // 8. Special approval requirements

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    332
                                    
            if (compliance.requireApproval && amount >= compliance.approvalThreshold) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    333
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Review, "Manual approval required");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    334
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    335
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    336
                                    
            // 9. Cooldown period for large transactions

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    337
                                    
            if (amount >= policy.maxAmount / 2 && 

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    338
                                    
                block.timestamp < policy.lastLargeTransaction + policy.cooldownPeriod) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    339
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Review, "Cooldown period active");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    340
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    341
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    342
                                    
            // 10. Trusted counterparty override (only affects Review → Approve)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    343
                                    
            if (trustedCounterparties[user][counterparty] && riskAction == PolicyAction.Review) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    344
                                    
                riskAction = PolicyAction.Approve;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    345
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    346
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    347
                                    
            // 11. LOW RISK: Auto-approval for low/minimal risk scores (< 400)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    348
                                    
            if (riskAction == PolicyAction.Approve) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    349
                                    
                _recordSuccessfulTransaction(user, amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    350
                                    
                emit LowRiskAutoApproved(user, counterparty, amount, dqnRiskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    351
                                    
                emit TransactionValidated(user, counterparty, amount, PolicyAction.Approve);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    352
                                    
                return (PolicyAction.Approve, "LOW_RISK: Auto-approved");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    353
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    354
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    355
                                    
            emit TransactionValidated(user, counterparty, amount, riskAction);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    356
                                    
            return (riskAction, _getRiskActionReason(dqnRiskScore, riskAction));

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    357
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    358
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    359
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    360
                                    
         * @dev Assess risk using your DQN model scores

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    361
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    362
                                    
        function _assessDQNRisk(uint256 riskScore, RiskPolicy memory policy) internal pure returns (PolicyAction) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    363
                                    
            if (riskScore <= policy.minimalThreshold) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    364
                                    
                return policy.minimalAction;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    365
                                    
            } else if (riskScore <= policy.lowThreshold) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    366
                                    
                return policy.lowAction;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    367
                                    
            } else if (riskScore <= policy.mediumThreshold) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    368
                                    
                return policy.mediumAction;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    369
                                    
            } else {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    370
                                    
                return policy.highAction;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    371
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    372
                                    
        }

    /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    102

                                    121

                                    122
                                    
     *    └─────────────────┬───────────────────────┘

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    123
                                    
     *                      │

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    124

                                    127
                                    
     */

    contract AMTTPRouter is

                                    133
                                    
    {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    134

        //                           STATE

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

                                    157
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    158
                                    
        enum SwapType { NONE, ETH, ERC20, NFT_TO_ETH, NFT_TO_NFT }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    159
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    160
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    161
                                    
        //                           EVENTS

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        event AnalyticsUpdated(uint256 totalSwaps, uint256 totalCompleted, uint256 totalVolumeETH);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    167
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    168
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    169
                                    
        //                        INITIALIZATION

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    170
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    171
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    172
                                    
        /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor

        function initialize(

            address _core,

            coreContract = IAMTTPCore(_core);

                                    194
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    195
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    196
                                    
        //                     CONFIGURATION

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    197
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    198
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    199
                                    
        function setContracts(

                                    217
                                    
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    218
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    219
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    220

                                    221
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    222
                                    
        function swapETH(

            _recordSwap(swapId, SwapType.ETH, msg.sender, msg.value);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    242

                                    246
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    247

                                    250

                                    252

                                    253
                                    
            uint256 amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    254
                                    
            bytes32 hashlock,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    255
                                    
            uint256 timelock,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    256
                                    
            uint256 riskScore,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    257

                                    258

                                    259

                                    263

                                    264
                                    
                token,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    265
                                    
                amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    266
                                    
                hashlock,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    267

                                    268

                                    186
                                    
        function checkTransaction(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    187
                                    
            address to,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    188
                                    
            uint256 value,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    189
                                    
            bytes memory data,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    190
                                    
            uint8 operation,

                                    192

                                    198
                                    
        ) external override {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    199
                                    
            address safe = msg.sender;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    200
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    201
                                    
            if (!registeredSafes[safe] || !safeConfigs[safe].enabled) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    202
                                    
                return; // Skip if not registered or disabled

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    203

                                    211
                                    
            // Check single transaction limit

            SafeConfig memory config = safeConfigs[safe];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    213
                                    
            if (config.singleTxLimit > 0) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    214

                                    221

                                    223

                                    225
                                    
                (uint256 riskScore, string memory reason) = _getRiskAssessment(safe, to, value, data);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    226
                                    
                

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    227

                                    228
                                    
                

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    229

                                    238
                                    
                }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    239
                                    
                

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    240
                                    
                _logAudit(txHash, safe, riskScore, RiskAction.Allow, reason);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    241
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    242
                                    
        }

        /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor

                                    102
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    103
                                    
            _mint(msg.sender, initialSupply);

                                    108
                                    
        /**

                                    111
                                    
        function setPolicyManager(address _policyManager) external onlyOwner {

                                    113

                                    116
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    117
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    118

                                    119
                                    
         */

                                    124
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    125
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    126
                                    
         * @dev Update KYC status

         */

        function updateKYCStatus(address user, bool verified) external onlyOracle {

                                    132
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    133
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    134
                                    
         * @dev Initiate secure transfer

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    135
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    136
                                    
        function secureTransfer(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    137
                                    
            address to,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    138
                                    
            uint256 amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    139
                                    
            bytes32 dataHash

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    140
                                    
        ) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (bytes32 txId) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    141

                                    142

                                    143
                                    
            require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    144
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    145
                                    
            txId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, to, amount, block.timestamp, block.number));

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    146
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    147
                                    
            transactions[txId] = Transaction({

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    148
                                    
                from: msg.sender,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    149
                                    
                to: to,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    150
                                    
                amount: amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    151
                                    
                timestamp: block.timestamp,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    152
                                    
                riskScore: 0,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    153
                                    
                status: 0,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    154
                                    
                dataHash: dataHash

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    155
                                    
            });

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    156
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    157
                                    
            emit TransactionInitiated(txId, msg.sender, to, amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    158
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    159
                                    
            // Auto-approve if policy validation disabled or not risky

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    160
                                    
            if (!policyValidationEnabled) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    161
                                    
                _approveTransaction(txId, 0);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    162
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    163
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    164
                                    
            return txId;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    165
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    166
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    167
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    168
                                    
         * @dev Submit risk score and validate transaction

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    169
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    170
                                    
        function submitRiskScore(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    171
                                    
            bytes32 txId,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    172
                                    
            uint256 riskScore

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    173
                                    
        ) external onlyOracle validTransaction(txId) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    174
                                    
            require(transactions[txId].status == 0, "Transaction already processed");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    175
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    176
                                    
            Transaction storage txn = transactions[txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    177
                                    
            uint256 oldScore = txn.riskScore;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    178
                                    
            txn.riskScore = riskScore;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    179
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    180
                                    
            emit RiskScoreUpdated(txId, oldScore, riskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    181
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    182
                                    
            // Validate with policy manager if enabled

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    183
                                    
            if (policyValidationEnabled && address(policyManager) != address(0)) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    184
                                    
                (bool allowed, uint8 riskLevel, string memory reason) = policyManager.validateTransaction(

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    185
                                    
                    txn.from,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    186
                                    
                    txn.to,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    187
                                    
                    txn.amount,

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    188
                                    
                    riskScore

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    189
                                    
                );

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    190
                                    
                

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    191
                                    
                if (!allowed) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    192
                                    
                    _rejectTransaction(txId, reason);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    193
                                    
                } else if (riskLevel >= 3) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    194
                                    
                    _escrowTransaction(txId);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    195
                                    
                } else {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    196
                                    
                    _approveTransaction(txId, riskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    197
                                    
                }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    198
                                    
            } else {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    199
                                    
                // Fallback validation

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    200
                                    
                if (riskScore >= 800) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    201
                                    
                    _rejectTransaction(txId, "High risk");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    202
                                    
                } else if (riskScore >= 600) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    203
                                    
                    _escrowTransaction(txId);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    204
                                    
                } else {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    205
                                    
                    _approveTransaction(txId, riskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    206
                                    
                }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    207
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    208
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    209
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    210
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    211
                                    
         * @dev Approve transaction

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    212
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    213
                                    
        function _approveTransaction(bytes32 txId, uint256 riskScore) internal {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    214
                                    
            Transaction storage txn = transactions[txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    215
                                    
            txn.status = 1;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    216
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    217
                                    
            // Execute transfer

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    218
                                    
            _transfer(txn.from, txn.to, txn.amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    219
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    220
                                    
            // Update user profiles

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    221

                                    222

                                    223
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    224
                                    
            emit TransactionApproved(txId, riskScore);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    225
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    226
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    227
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    228
                                    
         * @dev Reject transaction

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    229
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    230
                                    
        function _rejectTransaction(bytes32 txId, string memory reason) internal {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    231
                                    
            transactions[txId].status = 2;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    232

                                    233
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    234
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    235
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    236
                                    
         * @dev Escrow transaction for manual review

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    237
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    238
                                    
        function _escrowTransaction(bytes32 txId) internal {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    239
                                    
            Transaction storage txn = transactions[txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    240
                                    
            txn.status = 3;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    241
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    242
                                    
            // Lock funds (simplified - in production would use proper escrow)

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    243
                                    
            _transfer(txn.from, address(this), txn.amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    244

                                    247
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    248
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    249
                                    
         * @dev Release escrowed transaction

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    250
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    251
                                    
        function releaseEscrow(bytes32 txId, bool approve) external onlyOracle validTransaction(txId) {

                                    254
                                    
            Transaction storage txn = transactions[txId];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    255
                                    
            

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    256
                                    
            if (approve) {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    257
                                    
                _transfer(address(this), txn.to, txn.amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    258
                                    
                txn.status = 1;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    259

                                    260

                                    261

                                    262
                                    
            } else {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    263
                                    
                _transfer(address(this), txn.from, txn.amount);

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    264
                                    
                txn.status = 2;

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    265
                                    
                emit TransactionRejected(txId, txn.riskScore, "Manual rejection");

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    266
                                    
            }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    267
                                    
        }

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    268
                                    
        

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    269
                                    
        /**

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    270
                                    
         * @dev Update user profile

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    271
                                    
         */

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    272
                                    
        function _updateUserProfile(address user, uint256 amount, bool isSender) internal {

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    273
                                    
            UserProfile storage profile = userProfiles[user];

    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    274
